---
title: "Suicide mortality in Indiana counties, 2018-2024"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: cosmo
    source_code: embed
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# One-time install (run in the console, not in this document):
# install.packages(c("flexdashboard","shiny","sf","dplyr","stringr","readr",
#                    "readxl","ggplot2","plotly","leaflet","DT","tigris",
#                    "RColorBrewer"))

library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# ---- 1. File locations: edit these if your files are named/placed differently
FILE_YEARS  <- "data/IN Suicide Rates Years.xlsx"    # county x year
FILE_POOLED <- "data/IN Suicide Rates Pooled.xlsx"   # county, 2018-2024 pooled

VIEW_ANNUAL <- "Annual data (choose years)"
VIEW_POOLED <- "Pooled 2018-2024"

# ---- 2. Reader for CDC WONDER exports
# WONDER's ".xls" is usually tab-delimited text with the extension changed.
# This reads either a true Excel file or a tab-delimited file, all as text.
read_wonder <- function(path, need) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Cannot find '", path, "'. Put the file in a 'data' folder next to ",
         "this .Rmd, or edit FILE_YEARS / FILE_POOLED in the setup chunk.")
  }
  magic <- readBin(path, "raw", n = 4)
  is_excel <- identical(magic[1:2], as.raw(c(0xD0, 0xCF))) ||   # old .xls
              identical(magic[1:2], as.raw(c(0x50, 0x4B)))      # .xlsx
  df <- if (is_excel) {
    readxl::read_excel(path, col_types = "text")
  } else {
    suppressWarnings(readr::read_tsv(path, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                                     progress = FALSE))
  }
  names(df) <- str_trim(names(df))
  miss <- setdiff(need, names(df))
  if (length(miss)) {
    stop("'", path, "' is missing expected column(s): ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
         ". Columns found: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (!"Notes" %in% names(df)) df$Notes <- NA_character_
  df$Notes <- coalesce(df$Notes, "")
  df
}

to_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace_all(x, ",", "")))

# ---- 3. Pooled file: one row per county; keep the "Total" row for the reference rate
pooled_raw <- read_wonder(FILE_POOLED, c("County Code", "Deaths", "Population"))

pooled <- pooled_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(`County Code`), Notes != "Total") |>
  transmute(fips   = str_pad(str_trim(`County Code`), 5, pad = "0"),
            deaths = to_num(Deaths),            # "Suppressed" becomes NA
            pop    = to_num(Population))

# Indiana reference rate (deaths per person-year, 2018-2024), used to compute
# expected counts. Best source: the WONDER "Total" row, which includes
# suppressed counties.
tot <- pooled_raw |> filter(Notes == "Total", is.na(`County Code`))
if (nrow(tot) > 0) {
  ref_rate <- to_num(tot$Deaths[1]) / to_num(tot$Population[1])
  ref_note <- "Reference: Indiana 2018-2024 crude rate (from the WONDER total row)."
} else {
  ok <- !is.na(pooled$deaths)
  ref_rate <- sum(pooled$deaths[ok]) / sum(pooled$pop[ok])
  ref_note <- paste("Reference: Indiana crude rate from non-suppressed counties only",
                    "(re-export with 'Show Totals' for the exact statewide rate).")
}

# ---- 4. Annual file: one row per county and year
yrs_raw <- read_wonder(FILE_YEARS, c("County Code", "Year", "Deaths", "Population"))

yrs <- yrs_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(`County Code`), !is.na(Year), Notes != "Total") |>
  transmute(fips   = str_pad(str_trim(`County Code`), 5, pad = "0"),
            year   = as.integer(str_extract(Year, "\\d{4}")),
            deaths = to_num(Deaths),
            pop    = to_num(Population))

# ---- 5. County boundaries (Census, via tigris)
in_map <- counties(state = "IN", cb = TRUE, year = 2020, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  select(GEOID, NAME)

county_choices <- setNames(in_map$GEOID, in_map$NAME)
county_choices <- county_choices[order(names(county_choices))]
county_names   <- st_drop_geometry(in_map)

# WONDER leaves out county-years with 1-9 deaths instead of marking them, so
# an absent row means "suppressed". Rebuild the full county x year grid so
# those gaps are explicit (deaths = NA) rather than silently ignored.
yr_range <- range(yrs$year)
yrs <- yrs |>
  complete(fips = in_map$GEOID, year = seq(yr_range[1], yr_range[2]))
pct_observed <- round(100 * mean(!is.na(yrs$deaths)))

# Same SIR classes as the course example (Exercise 4)
sir_breaks <- c(0, 0.5, 2/3, 0.9, 1/0.9, 1.5, 2, Inf)
```

Column {.sidebar data-width=200}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r inputs}
radioButtons("view", "Data view",
             choices = c(VIEW_ANNUAL, VIEW_POOLED), selected = VIEW_ANNUAL)

selectInput("county", "County to highlight",
            choices = county_choices, selected = "18097")  # Marion

conditionalPanel(
  condition = sprintf("input.view == '%s'", VIEW_ANNUAL),
  sliderInput("years", "Years",
              min = min(yrs$year), max = max(yrs$year),
              value = range(yrs$year), step = 1, sep = "")
)
```

Choose a view, a county, and (for annual data) a range of years. The map,
time series and table update together.

**Grey counties** have no estimate: CDC WONDER withholds death counts of 1-9,
so a county is grey if its count is suppressed. In the annual view, a county is
grey if *any* selected year is suppressed; widen the year range or switch to
the pooled view to see more counties.

```{r refnote, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(paste0("<small>%s Rate = %.1f per 100,000 person-years. ",
                   "Only %d%% of county-years have a reported count.</small>"),
            ref_note, ref_rate * 1e5, pct_observed))
```

```{r reactive}
# Observed, expected and SIR by county, for the chosen view
by_county <- reactive({
  req(input$view)
  d <- if (input$view == VIEW_POOLED) {
    pooled |> transmute(GEOID = fips, Y = deaths, Pop = pop,
                        n_supp = as.integer(is.na(deaths)))
  } else {
    req(input$years)
    yrs |>
      filter(between(year, input$years[1], input$years[2])) |>
      group_by(GEOID = fips) |>
      summarise(n_supp = sum(is.na(deaths)),
                Y   = if (n_supp > 0) NA_real_ else sum(deaths),
                Pop = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop")
  }
  d |> mutate(E = Pop * ref_rate, SIR = Y / E)
})
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### SIR by county (black outline: selected county)

```{r map}
renderLeaflet({
  d <- left_join(in_map, by_county(), by = "GEOID") |>
    mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(SIR),
                          sprintf("%s: not shown (suppressed or missing)", NAME),
                          sprintf("%s: SIR %.2f (%.0f observed, %.1f expected)",
                                  NAME, SIR, Y, E)))
  
  bb <- st_bbox(in_map)

  pal <- colorBin(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdBu")),
                  domain = c(0, 1000), bins = sir_breaks, na.color = "#BDBDBD")

  title <- if (input$view == VIEW_POOLED) "SIR<br>2018-2024"
           else paste0("SIR<br>", input$years[1], "-", input$years[2])

  leaflet(d) |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
fitBounds(bb[["xmin"]], bb[["ymin"]], bb[["xmax"]], bb[["ymax"]]) |>
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(SIR), fillOpacity = 0.85,
      color = "white", weight = 1, label = ~label,
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "black",
                                          bringToFront = TRUE)
    ) |>
    addPolygons(data = filter(d, GEOID == input$county),   # selected county
                fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 3) |>
    addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~SIR, title = title,
              na.label = "Suppressed / missing",
              labFormat = labelFormat(digits = 2), opacity = 0.85)
})
```

> SIR = observed / expected suicide deaths, where expected is each county's
> population times the Indiana 2018-2024 rate. Red: more deaths than
> expected; blue: fewer. This is a *crude* ratio (not age-adjusted), and
> small counties are unstable even when not suppressed. Source: CDC WONDER,
> Underlying Cause of Death 2018-2024 (ICD-10 X60-X84, Y87.0). Boundaries:
> US Census Bureau via `tigris`.

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### SIR by year, selected county (grey band: selected years; dashed line: Indiana rate) {data-height=330}

```{r timeseries}
renderPlotly({
  one <- yrs |>
    filter(fips == input$county) |>
    mutate(E = pop * ref_rate, SIR = deaths / E,
           txt = ifelse(is.na(deaths),
                        paste0(year, ": suppressed (1-9 deaths)"),
                        sprintf("%d: SIR %.2f (%.0f deaths)", year, SIR, deaths)))

  validate(need(any(!is.na(one$SIR)),
                "Every year is suppressed for this county. Try the pooled view."))

  p <- ggplot(one, aes(year, SIR)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_line(aes(group = 1), colour = "#B2182B", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(text = txt), colour = "#B2182B", size = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(yrs$year))) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "SIR (vs Indiana 2018-2024 rate)") +
    theme_minimal()

  if (!is.null(input$view) && input$view == VIEW_ANNUAL && !is.null(input$years)) {
    p <- p + annotate("rect", xmin = input$years[1] - 0.5, xmax = input$years[2] + 0.5,
                      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.4)
  }

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```

> Gaps in the line are years where the county's death count was suppressed (1-9 deaths).

### Counties, selected view {data-height =670}

```{r table}
renderDT({
  sel <- county_names$NAME[county_names$GEOID == input$county]

  by_county() |>
    left_join(county_names, by = "GEOID") |>
    transmute(County   = NAME,
              Observed = ifelse(is.na(Y), "Suppressed", as.character(Y)),
              Expected = round(E, 1),
              SIR      = round(SIR, 2)) |>
    arrange(desc(SIR)) |>
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollx=TRUE)) |>
    formatStyle("County", target = "row",
                fontWeight = styleEqual(sel, "bold"))
})
```
